entities.name: House Bikov
entities.description: One of the five powerful houses of Arathoxia, also called House Sapphire, ruled by Marshall Bikov.

entities.name: Marshall Bikov
entities.description: Merfolk lord of House Bikov, ally of Lady Verdenth, killed by the Chaos Orb.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: City on Corondor with five powerful houses.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A battlemage who invaded Arathoxia and later held the blue Mox.

entities.name: Chaos Orb
entities.description: Ravidel's weapon that obliterated House Bikov and its leader.

entities.name: Lady Verdenth
entities.description: Ally of Marshall Bikov during the invasion.

events.summary: House Bikov was destroyed in Ravidel's invasion of Arathoxia, obliterated with its leader by the Chaos Orb.
events.quote: House Bikov was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of Arathoxia

relations.note: He was killed by the Chaos Orb.
